label: synthetic
description: Synthetic $12,000 fixed-price engagement comparing a quote with no deposit against two counteroffers. Costs: $800/wk for five weeks then $840, floor $2,000 against $5,000 opening cash. Every final payment is on_acceptance with delivery 2027-01-22, a 3-day acceptance window and net-7 terms; the three delays (acceptance window, scenario acceptanceDelayDays, scenario paymentLagDays) stay separate components. Scenarios: on_time (no adjustments); acceptance_delay_21d (client accepts 21 days late); payment_lag_14d (client pays 14 days after the due date); extra_cost_500 (a $500 unplanned cost on 2027-01-22). Client payments and escrow releases landing on a Saturday or Sunday are received the next Monday; costs never move. A candidate passes only if the cash balance never drops below the floor in all four scenarios; smallestPassingCandidate is the passing candidate with the smallest deposit (rankCents). All amounts are integer cents.
